name: Mixed Fruit Jam
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Banana Pulp, Pineapple Pulp, Papaya Pulp, Gauva Pulp, Mango Pulp, Water, Thickener (INS440), Acidity Regulator (INS330), Preservatives (INS211, INS224) CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVES (INS211 & INS224), PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS (INS122 & INS124) & ADDED FLAVOR. (NATURAL, ARTIFICIAL MIXED FRUIT FLAVORING SUBSTANCE). Allergy Instructions: This product was processed on machinery and in a plant that also processes Wheat, Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Sesame Soya and Milk Solids.
